verdict.rationale: Xero ships an official MCP server and AI Toolkit (OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain, prompt examples) that expose live ledger data (contacts, chart of accounts, invoices) via API/MCP, which could ground an agent's answer to affordability-type questions, and the full API/SDK covers broader financial data. However the MCP server's documented tool set only lists contacts, chart of accounts and invoices — not explicit cash-flow/balance/profit-loss reporting endpoints — so a live 'can we afford X' answer grounded in full financial reporting isn't directly evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit MCP/reporting endpoint coverage for cash flow/balance sheet data, and a documented example of an agent answering an affordability question using live data.
